## Check DNS

```bash
# cat /etc/resolv.conf 

# Generated by Docker Engine.
# This file can be edited; Docker Engine will not make further changes once it
# has been modified.

nameserver 127.0.0.11
options ndots:0


# getent hosts payment-service 
172.21.0.3        payment-service  payment-service

```
